verdict.rationale: Swell documents environment-specific secret keys: sk_test_ keys route requests to the store's test environment, while sk_live_ keys target live data. Its CLI also pushes app configuration to a development store and can switch the default store, so an agent can work against non-production data. missing for 10: documentation of how test data is isolated, seeded or reset, explicit agent-oriented sandbox workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
